name: mask_all_255
applies_to: all races masks (vmangos 255 = DB2 -1), data-plan.md 5

name: bag_family_mask
inverse: CASE WHEN {v} = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST(ROUND(LOG({v}) / LOG(2)) AS INTEGER) + 1) END
applies_to: item_template.bag_family (vmangos id N = DB2 mask 1 << (N-1)), data-plan.md 5

name: cooldown_default

inverse: CASE WHEN {v} = 0 THEN -1 WHEN {v} = -1 THEN 0 ELSE {v} END
applies_to: item spell cooldowns (vmangos 0/-1 = DB2 -1/0), data-plan.md 5

name: area_flag_added_bit
applies_to: area_template.flags / vdbc_areatable.Flags (client adds 0x40000000), data-plan.md 5

name: skill_race_flag_dropped_bit
applies_to: SkillRaceClassInfo flags (client dropped bit 0x400), data-plan.md 5

name: school_index_to_mask
applies_to: spell_template.school vs SpellMisc.SchoolMask (vanilla index, DB2 mask; 21037/21040 on shared spells. The constant 0x200 seen earlier was a WDC5 decode bug: SchoolMask is 8 bits), spell-plan.md 4.4

name: passive_duration_infinite
applies_to: spell_template.DurationIndex on passives (client drops the index), spell-plan.md 4.4

name: effect_base_dice_from_sides
applies_to: default of spell_extra.effect_base_diceN when it has no value: DieSides ? 1 : 0 (26,893 of 27,013 vanilla effects); not evaluated by spec evidence, there is no client column to join

name: superseded_by_spell_inverse
applies_to: skill_line_ability.superseded_by_spell vs SkillLineAbility.SupercedesSpell on the *next* rank's row (next/previous rank inverted); needs a second lookup against the counterpart table, not a value transform -- not evaluated by `spec evidence` yet, see phase0-plan.md 4.3's known gaps, data-plan.md 5

name: mail_body_newline
applies_to: mail_text_template.content_default vs MailTemplate.Body_lang (DB2 uses \r\n where the DB has a space), data-plan.md 5 -- approximate, not verified against the reference database yet

name: creature_gender_none
applies_to: creature_display_info_addon.gender vs CreatureDisplayInfo.Gender (vmangos 2 "none" = DB2 0), data-plan.md 5 -- inverse is lossy, DB2 0 also means genuine Male

name: quest_reward_xp_difficulty
applies_to: quest_template.RewXP vs dbc_questxp[QuestLevel].Difficulty[0..9] (find the index whose value matches RewXP); needs a second lookup against dbc_questxp, not a scalar transform -- not evaluated by spec evidence, stuff-plan.md 8.4

name: quest_reward_money_difficulty
applies_to: quest_template.RewOrReqMoney/RewMoneyMaxLevel vs dbc_questmoneyreward[QuestLevel].Difficulty[0..9]; same shape as quest_reward_xp_difficulty -- not evaluated by spec evidence, stuff-plan.md 8.4

name: quest_item_from_loot
applies_to: creature_quest_item/gameobject_quest_item.ItemId: item ids quest_template's ReqItemId1-4/ReqSourceId1-4 need that also appear in the creature's/game object's loot table; a multi-table derivation, not a scalar transform -- not evaluated by spec evidence, stuff-plan.md 8.4

inverse: CASE {v} WHEN 252 THEN 5 WHEN 325 THEN 45 WHEN 326 THEN 59 WHEN 327 THEN 70 WHEN 328 THEN 80 WHEN 320 THEN 104 WHEN 321 THEN 105 WHEN 322 THEN 106 WHEN 323 THEN 107 WHEN 329 THEN 113 ELSE {v} END

The summon variants all become 28, with the variant in EffectMiscValue2 (SummonProperties), so the inverse of 28 needs that column. Kind targeted: only for these columns, not tried by the counterpart search

name: spell_aura_client_number
expr: CASE {v} WHEN 70 THEN 551 WHEN 71 THEN 552 WHEN 73 THEN 553 WHEN 125 THEN 556 WHEN 128 THEN 378 WHEN 141 THEN 557 WHEN 143 THEN 558 WHEN 145 THEN 559 WHEN 148 THEN 560 WHEN 150 THEN 561 WHEN 153 THEN 562 WHEN 157 THEN 563 WHEN 158 THEN 564 WHEN 160 THEN 565 WHEN 165 THEN 566 WHEN 169 THEN 547 WHEN 179 THEN 569 WHEN 182 THEN 571 WHEN 183 THEN 572 WHEN 188 THEN 573 ELSE {v} END
inverse: CASE {v} WHEN 551 THEN 70 WHEN 552 THEN 71 WHEN 553 THEN 73 WHEN 556 THEN 125 WHEN 378 THEN 128 WHEN 557 THEN 141 WHEN 558 THEN 143 WHEN 559 THEN 145 WHEN 560 THEN 148 WHEN 561 THEN 150 WHEN 562 THEN 153 WHEN 563 THEN 157 WHEN 564 THEN 158 WHEN 565 THEN 160 WHEN 566 THEN 165 WHEN 547 THEN 169 WHEN 569 THEN 179 WHEN 571 THEN 182 WHEN 572 THEN 183 WHEN 573 THEN 188 ELSE {v} END
applies_to: spell_template.effectApplyAuraNameN vs SpellEffect.EffectAura: the 21 auras the client renumbered (plan.md A.6.2). Kind targeted: only for these columns, not tried by the counterpart search

name: family_flags_split
applies_to: spell_template.spellFamilyFlags (64 bits) vs SpellClassOptions.SpellClassMask1 (low 32 bits); the high 32 bits ({v} >> 32) go to SpellClassMask2, the inverse joins both. Kind targeted: only for these columns, not tried by the counterpart search

name: proc_chance_no_row
applies_to: spell_template.procChance vs SpellAuraOptions.ProcChance: identity where a row exists (the client keeps 101 too); a spell with no SpellAuraOptions row reads as 101, not 0 (plan.md A.6.4). Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: no_row_neg1
applies_to: spell_template.equippedItemClass vs SpellEquippedItems.EquippedItemClass, spell_template.stanceBarOrder vs SpellShapeshift.StanceBarOrder: identity where a row exists; no row reads as -1 (and for equipped items, the subclass/inventory masks are then unused). Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: effect_radius_slot
applies_to: spell_template.effectRadiusIndexN vs SpellEffect.EffectRadiusIndex[2]: the client keeps a radius per implicit target; the value goes to the slot the client row uses ([1] when non-zero, else [0]), and the loader reads [1] if non-zero, else [0] (plan.md A.6.4). Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: effect_item_type_class_mask
applies_to: spell_template.effectItemTypeN vs SpellEffect: on auras 107, 108, 109, 112 vanilla keeps a spell class mask in EffectItemType; the client moved it to EffectSpellClassMask1 (EffectItemType 0). Other effects: EffectItemType, identity. Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: bonus_coefficient_set
expr: CASE WHEN {v} < 0 THEN NULL ELSE {v} END
applies_to: spell_template.effectBonusCoefficientN vs SpellEffect.EffectBonusCoefficient: a real coefficient (>= 0) overwrites the client value; -1 (NULL here) leaves the client value and sets spell_extra.default_coefficientN. Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: bonus_coefficient_unset
applies_to: spell_extra.default_coefficientN from spell_template.effectBonusCoefficientN: 1 where vmangos has -1 (compute the default coefficient). Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: proc_ppm_row
applies_to: spell_proc_event.ppmRate vs SpellProcsPerMinute.BaseProcRate: create adds one SpellProcsPerMinute row per distinct rate (Flags 0, ids above the client's) and points the spell's SpellAuraOptions.SpellProcsPerMinuteID at it; the loader reads the rate through that link. Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: cone_default_60
applies_to: spell_cone.cone_degrees vs SpellTargetRestrictions.ConeDegrees: listed spells take their value; every other vanilla spell gets vmangos's default 60 (the client differs only on 30758 'aedm', 0); a spell with no SpellTargetRestrictions row reads as 60. Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: chain_rank_from_prev
inverse: CASE WHEN {v} = 0 THEN 1 ELSE {rank of {v}} + 1 END
applies_to: spell_chain.rank from prev_spell over the whole chain (spell_chain, SkillLineAbility, Talent): 1 for a first rank, else the previous rank's + 1. Not evaluated by spec evidence

name: chain_first_from_prev
inverse: CASE WHEN {v} = 0 THEN {spell_id} ELSE {first_spell of {v}} END
applies_to: spell_chain.first_spell from prev_spell over the whole chain: the spell itself for a first rank, else the previous rank's first spell. Not evaluated by spec evidence
